sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: The candidate is semantically faithful and deterministicValidation.valid is true. It preserves ship ownership, required operands and results, datatypes, units, exact inclusive constants, Table 3-2 values, the inclusive [5,20] clamp, registered math function IRIs, degree/radian conversion, explicit singular-input violation logic, and expected-result-scaled tolerances.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Reject: the candidate omits the required formula/readiness semantics for psi and the clamped geometry result. It must encode the supported math:sin, math:tan, and math:atan IRIs for psi = atan(tan(phi2)/sin(alpha)), including degree/radian conversion, singular-input rejection, and tolerance comparison, and must link the declared operands to the corresponding result rather than merely requiring presence. It also represents the derived clamped term only as a presence/range constraint, without faithfully encoding its operand relationship or derived-result tolerance. Preserve the supplied ship ownership, units, exact inclusive constants, and [5,20] clamp while adding these obligations.

Reject: the formula and supported math:sin, math:tan, and math:atan IRIs are present, but the singular-input filters are accidental pass logic. FILTER(ABS(math:cos(?phiRadians)) > ...) and FILTER(ABS(math:sin(?alphaRadians)) > ...) suppress the query result when an input is singular, allowing invalid data to pass. Make singular phi or alpha an explicit violation (or otherwise require non-singularity through a constraint) while retaining the degree/radian conversion, formula pairing, and expected-result-scaled tolerances. Preserve the existing ship ownership, units, exact inclusive constants, Table 3-2 values, and [5,20] clamp.

Reject: preserve the prior instructions and add the missing Complex-readiness semantics. The candidate only requires presence of flareAngle and clampedHullGeometryTerm; it does not link the declared operands to either result. Encode psi = atan(tan(phi2)/sin(alpha)) using the registered math:sin, math:tan, and math:atan XPath IRIs, with degree/radian conversion, explicit singular-input rejection (not FILTER-based accidental pass logic), and a tolerance scaled from the expected result. Also encode the operand relationship for ((L*T)/B^2)^3 and its inclusive clamp to [5,20], with the corresponding derived-result tolerance. Retain all declared ship ownership, operands, exact inclusive Table 3-2 and C3-C5 constants, datatypes, and units; full external formula execution is not required beyond the declared readiness semantics.

The candidate is semantically faithful and deterministicValidation.valid is true. It preserves ship ownership, required operands and results, datatypes, units, exact inclusive constants, Table 3-2 values, the inclusive [5,20] clamp, registered math function IRIs, degree/radian conversion, explicit singular-input violation logic, and expected-result-scaled tolerances.
